name: Seafood Chowder
description: A hearty seafood chowder featuring shrimp, clams, potatoes, and creamed corn in a flavorful broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté chopped bacon in a saucepan until cooked, then drain off excess fat.
Sauté the chopped onion and cubed potatoes in the bacon fat until tender.
Add the remaining ingredients (shrimp, clams, milk, creamed corn, broth, Worcestershire sauce) to the saucepan.
Heat through and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes.

keywords: seafood chowder, shrimp and clam soup, creamy chowder

_similar.name: Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder with bacon, potatoes, and a touch of milk.
recipeIngredient: 1½ cups frozen or fresh corn kernels

recipeInstructions.text: Chop bacon and sauté in a large heavy pot with onions for 5 minutes.
Add celery and cook until onions are transparent.
Stir in flour, salt, and pepper. Cook for 4 minutes.
Gradually blend in hot stock, then add potatoes. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add corn and simmer for another 10 minutes, or until vegetables are tender.
Scald milk and add to soup for desired consistency.

_similar.keywords: corn chowder, creamy soup, bacon soup

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Crab & Cheese Platter
_similar.description: A layered seafood appetizer featuring a creamy cheese base topped with cocktail sauce and crab meat.
recipeIngredient: 2 large packages (8 oz each) cream cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise and onion flakes in a blender, or beat with an electric mixer, until smooth and creamy.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the surface of a large round platter, leaving room around the outside for a row of crackers.
Press the centre of the cheese mixture down lightly to make a slightly raised border, about ½ to 1 in wide, around the outer edge.
Spread seafood cocktail sauce over the cheese layer within this border, leaving an outside rim of the cheese layer showing.
Drain the crab meat and spread it over the sauce layer, again leaving a border of seafood sauce showing.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, layered platter, seafood appetizer

_similar.name: Shrimp Spread
_similar.description: A savory shrimp and cheddar cheese spread served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.
Mash the shrimp with a fork until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving with crackers.

_similar.keywords: shrimp spread, seafood dip, party appetizer
